units.characteristics: righteousness above ritual; intent qualifying the offering
units.gist: doing righteousness/justice more acceptable than sacrifice; the wicked's sacrifice abomination, worse with evil intent (w/ Ecc 5:1)

units.characteristics: diligence stores, haste and folly squander
units.gist: diligent plans -> abundance, haste -> poverty; treasure in the wise dwelling, the fool devours it

units.characteristics: the crooked way and its self-destroying recoil
units.gist: lying-gotten treasure a snare of death; the wicked's violence sweeps them; the guilty's crooked way vs the pure's upright; wandering to the assembly of the dead

units.characteristics: the strife-filled home the self flees
units.gist: better a roof-corner / a desert than a house with a quarrelsome wife (w/ 17:1)

units.characteristics: the scoffer as arrogant pride; learning by another's punishment
units.gist: scoffer punished -> the simple grow wise; 'scoffer' = the arrogant haughty man of pride (thread w/ 19:25, 9:7-9)

units.characteristics: God's watch; mercy's reciprocity; justice as joy-or-terror
units.gist: the Righteous One observes the wicked's house; closing the ear to the poor -> unanswered; the secret gift averts anger; justice a joy to the righteous, terror to evildoers (w/ Matt 5:7)

units.characteristics: the pursuit that finds life; wisdom over might; the listening word endures
units.gist: pursuing righteousness+kindness finds life, righteousness, honour; a wise man scales the mighty city; the word of one who hears endures (w/ 8:17, Ecc 9:16)

units.characteristics: a good name valued above riches
units.gist: a good name chosen rather than great riches; favour better than silver or gold (thread - the interior's value-ranking, w/ 16:16)

units.characteristics: rich and poor of one Maker, under God's watching eyes
units.gist: rich and poor meet, the LORD Maker of all; the eyes of the LORD keep watch over knowledge and overthrow the traitor (w/ Job 31:15, Pro 15:3)

units.characteristics: the shaping of the young interior; folly native to the child's heart
units.gist: train up a child in the way; folly bound up in the child's heart, the rod drives it far - early formation sets the lifelong way

units.characteristics: the poor and the LORD who pleads their cause; oppression's recoil
units.gist: the rich rule the poor; oppressing the poor -> poverty; do not rob the poor, the LORD will plead their cause (w/ 23:11, Job 31:13-15)

units.characteristics: the bountiful eye vs sown injustice
units.gist: sowing injustice reaps calamity; the bountiful eye is blessed, sharing bread with the poor (the open vs grasping eye, w/ 23:6)

units.characteristics: the strife-source scoffer; the sluggard's invented danger; the seductive pit
units.gist: drive out the scoffer, strife goes; the sluggard's 'lion outside!' excuse; the mouth of forbidden women a deep pit

units.characteristics: words wasted on the closed/unreceptive self
units.gist: vomit up the morsels, waste your pleasant words; do not speak to a fool, he despises the good sense of your words

units.characteristics: the strong Redeemer/advocate of the defenceless
units.gist: their Redeemer is strong; he will plead their cause against you (go'el, w/ Job 19:25, Pro 22:23)

units.characteristics: discipline as soul-rescue; reverence for the aged parent
units.gist: strike him with the rod, save his soul from Sheol; listen to your father who gave you life, do not despise your aged mother (w/ 19:18)

units.characteristics: the parent's joy in a wise child (the glad pole)
units.gist: the father of the righteous greatly rejoices; let your father and mother be glad, let her who bore you rejoice (thread w/ 10:1, 17:21)
be not among drunkards or gluttons; buy truth and do not sell it, buy wisdom (appetite-restraint; truth prized w/ Job 28:15)

units.characteristics: the seductive pit that lies in wait
units.gist: a prostitute a deep pit, an adulteress a narrow well; she lies in wait like a robber (thread w/ 22:14, 5-7)
